title: Water and Jug Problem
description: Determine if you can measure exactly target liters of water using two jugs with capacities jug1Capacity and jug2Capacity.

steps.note: Check if total capacity is less than target. jug1=3, jug2=5, target=4.
Calculate GCD(3, 5) which is 1. Check if target 4 is divisible by 1.
